notes: Contraction mirror of biology-replace-0002: removes the revision's original fact (scurvy is caused by a deficiency of vitamin C). caused_by_deficiency_of is functional; the cardinality question asks vitamin D (the vitamin the revision swapped in): 'no' before, 'does not know' after, assuming no separately stored denial (to be counted). The derived questions go through the vitamin by description and use two facts stored about vitamin C by name that are not tied to scurvy: it is water-soluble, and humans cannot make it. Questions about citrus, oranges, ascorbic acid and gum symptoms were avoided because each is tied to scurvy in text and would give a second route to vitamin C.
